description_en: Modifies a global message backup plan
name: UpdateDisasterRecoveryPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the global message backup plan
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic consumer progress synchronization.

This parameter takes effect only when you set `syncCheckpointEnabled` to true.

Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启消费进度自动同步。

只有在开启消费进度同步时有效。即 `syncCheckpointEnabled`字段值为true
parameters.name: auto_sync_checkpoint

fields.help_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

NO_AUTH: no authentication
ACL_AUTH: access control list (ACL)-based authentication

<!---->

*
*
fields.help_zh:
认证方式
NO_AUTH：无需认证
ACL_AUTH：acl认证
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_zh:
消费者组ID，用于从源实例拉取消息。
<notice>自建实例必须填写，阿里云实例会自动生成。</notice>
fields.name: consumer_group_id

fields.help_en: The instance endpoint. This parameter is required only if you set instanceType to EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ
fields.help_zh: 接入点地址，instanceType实例类型为ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ无须填写，EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ需要填写
fields.name: endpoint_url

fields.help_en:
The instance role. Valid values:

ACTIVE: primary instance
Passive: secondary instance
fields.help_zh:
实例角色，主或者备
ACTIVE：主
PASSIVE：备
fields.name: instance_role

fields.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ: ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ: open source RocketMQ cluster
fields.help_zh:
实例类型：
ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ ：阿里云实例
EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ ：外部实例，开源实例，开源集群
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The message attribute. When you synchronize a message to the destination cluster, the system automatically adds the attribute to the message for SQL-based filtering
fields.help_zh: 消息过滤属性，消息同步到目标集群时，会自动添加上该属性，用于消息消费时进行SQL过滤
fields.name: message_property

fields.help_en:
The network type. This parameter is required only if you set instanceType to EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ. Valid values:

TCP_INTERNET: Internet over TCP
TCP_VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC) over TCP
fields.help_zh:
网络类型，instanceType实例类型为ALIYUN_ROCKETMQ无须填写，EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ需要填写 参数取值如下：
TCP_INTERNET：tcp公网
TCP_VPC：tcp专有网络
fields.name: network_type

fields.help_en: The password used for authentication. This parameter is required only if you set authType to ACL_AUTH
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs. This parameter is required only if you set instanceType to EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ and networkType to TCP_VPC
fields.help_zh: 安全组id，nstanceType实例类型仅为EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ，networkType为TCP_VPC时需要填写
fields.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The username used for authentication. This parameter is required only if you set authType to ACL_AUTH
fields.name: username

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch with which the instance is associated. This parameter is required only if you set instanceType to EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ and networkType to TCP_VPC
fields.help_zh: 实例所关联的交换机ID，nstanceType实例类型仅为EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ，networkType为TCP_VPC时需要填写
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the VPC with which the instance is associated. This parameter is required only if you set instanceType to EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ and networkType to TCP_VPC
fields.help_zh: 创建实例所关联的专有网络的ID，nstanceType实例类型仅为EXTERNAL_ROCKETMQ，networkType为TCP_VPC时需要填写
fields.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The instances involved in the Global Replicator task. After you create a Global Replicator task, you cannot change the instances involved in the task. You can change only the message attribute and authentication type of the task
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划参与实例。不支持修改实例，只支持修改实例下面messageProperty消息过滤条件，auth认证方式
parameters.name: instances

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Global Replicator task. After you create a Global Replicator task, you cannot change the type of the task. Valid values:

ACTIVE_PASSIVE: one-way backup
ACTIVE_ACTIVE: two-way backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份任务类，不支持修改。参数取值如下：
ACTIVE_PASSIVE：单向备份
ACTIVE_ACTIVE：双向备份
parameters.name: plan_type
